verdict.rationale:
Bolt supports two-way GitHub sync (connect a repo, sync commits automatically, work across branches, create a new repo from a project, import an existing repo), which enables a workflow of editing locally and pushing back via git. However, there is no explicit documentation of a local dev-server/CLI experience, editor-agnostic setup, or confirmation that local pushes reliably re-sync into Bolt's live sandbox without conflicts.
missing for 10: explicit local-editor workflow docs, CLI/local dev tooling support, independent confirmation that local pushes sync cleanly back into the platform.
